Name: Carissa Schroer
Badge: Reading to Write: They Say / I Say
Which version of the They Say / I Say routine (with visual texts or with annotation) feels like the best fit for your students right now? Why?:

I like the paragraph response writing for this routine. I used a passage from our class novel and walked them through responding to the text using inferencing skills.

Describe one way you might adapt the They Say / I Say framework to align with the types of texts your students read most often (e.g., articles, visuals, multimodal texts).:

Our curriculum is novel based. We do a lot of writing in response to the text. Some of it is in small groups with me. Some of it is in student groups and some is independent. I like the idea of beginning with whole group modeling, then using it in my small groups, then releasing to student teams.

What, if anything, do you need help thinking through as you plan for using They Say / I Say in your classroom?:

I think the biggest challenge is focusing the inferences toward the end I want them to get to. Some classes are better at discussion than others. The hesitant ones will be more challenging to lead to the desired outcome.
